archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with Amber admin accent

typography.notes: No Inter. Use Cabinet Grotesk for tight, authoritative admin headings. IBM Plex Sans for crisp, technical data legibility.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale. p-6 or p-8 for cards. Dense tables for data.
spacing_and_layout.desktop: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Content max-width optimized for large screens.
spacing_and_layout.mobile: Bottom navigation or Hamburger menu. Main content uses stacked cards instead of horizontal tables.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) or Flat with 1px subtle border. No heavy soft shadows. Crisp and clean.
spacing_and_layout.drawer: Use Sheet (shadcn) on right side for Desktop (w-[500px] or w-1/3), Bottom Sheet for Mobile.

dashboard.title: Métricas de Plataforma
components: Cards (MRR, Total Usuarios, Activos, En Trial, Comp)
Charts (Evolución de MRR, Crecimiento de usuarios)

accounts.title: Gestión de Cuentas
accounts.description: El corazón del admin. Lista de todos los usuarios.

user_detail_drawer.concept: A single Sheet/Drawer that opens when clicking a user in the Accounts Table. Consolidates all actions so the admin never leaves the accounts page.

tabs.name: Plan & Acceso
tabs.content: Dropdown to assign/change plan (Negocio/Presencia/Marketing/Bundle). Toggle for 'Acceso de cortesía (comp)' with Note field and Expiration Date picker.

tabs.name: Tarjetas NFC
tabs.content: Input for 'Límite de tarjetas NFC'. Toggle for 'Cobrar en próximo ciclo Stripe' or 'Gratis'.

tabs.name: Actividad
tabs.content: List of the user's specific NFC shipments and their specific Leads.

tabs.name: Acciones
tabs.content: Button 'Entrar como usuario' (Impersonate - amber warning color), Button 'Eliminar cuenta' (Destructive red color).

component_usage.sheet: Use for User Detail Drawer. Must be slide-in from right on desktop, bottom up on mobile.
component_usage.tabs: Use inside the Drawer to organize user details without cluttering.
component_usage.table: Shadcn Table for Desktop data lists. Dense padding.
component_usage.dropdown_menu: Use for actions on table rows (e.g., quick actions) and filters.
component_usage.command: Use for global search or user search.
component_usage.badge: Use to indicate statuses (Activo = Green, Trial = Blue, Comp = Purple, Sin Plan = Gray).

data_testids.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui (.js components, not .tsx).
Implement the Layout with a persistent Sidebar on desktop and bottom nav on mobile.
Ensure the 'Cuentas' section has a Table that triggers a Sheet (Drawer) on row click. This Sheet is the core of the redesign.
Implement the tabs inside the User Sheet exactly as defined.
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) for sidebar and action buttons.
Apply the Amber primary accent sparingly for key admin actions and impersonation to visually warn the super-admin.
Make sure all headings use the defined custom font and NOT Inter.
